content.text: Gumroad's payout schedule means you wait a week or a month to access money you already earned. PayPal's conversion rates take 3 to 5 percent of every international transfer. Wire transfers cost $20 to $50 each way and take three to seven business days. These are not small frictions — they are structural extraction from creators already operating in harder markets. USDT on Tron eliminates all of this. Settlement in under 60 seconds. Fee under $0.10. The full USD equivalent of your product price lands in your wallet the moment the on-chain transaction confirms. No manual verification. No waiting. P2P conversion to local currency at near-market rates completes the pipeline — typically within 30 minutes of the original sale.

content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies across multiple blockchain networks. For practical digital product sales, the most operationally useful options are USDT on Tron — fastest settlement under 60 seconds, fees under $0.10, widely held in restricted markets — USDT on Ethereum — higher fees but the most widely supported chain globally — Bitcoin — highest global recognition, 10 to 60 minute confirmation depending on network congestion — Solana — fast settlement, fees of fractions of a cent, growing adoption — and BNB on Binance Smart Chain — popular in Southeast Asia and widely available through Binance.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your NOWPayments webhook with Cloudflare Workers, you'll need to have a few things in place. First, ensure you have a Cloudflare account and are familiar with Cloudflare Workers. You'll also need to set up a NOWPayments account and generate an API key. Additionally, consider the digital products you want to sell and how you'll deliver them to your customers, such as through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-everything-you-15|COREMERCH guide to setting]] up your payment pipeline involves configuring your NOWPayments account to work with Cloudflare Workers. This includes creating a worker that listens for webhook notifications from NOWPayments and then triggers the delivery of your digital products. With Solana transaction fees averaging fractions of a cent per transaction, the cost of doing business just got a lot lower. You can use services like Supabase or Google Sheets to store order information and automate the delivery process.
Leverage NOWPayments for over 300 cryptocurrency options.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live with your NOWPayments webhook and Cloudflare Workers setup is an exciting step. Once everything is configured, you can start accepting crypto payments for your digital products. The moment a payment is confirmed on the blockchain, your Cloudflare Worker will receive the webhook notification from NOWPayments and initiate the product delivery. This automation ensures a seamless experience for both you and your customers, with no need to manually intervene in the process.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, so does the need for a scalable infrastructure. With Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, you have a solid foundation for handling increased traffic and sales. Consider optimizing your worker scripts for better performance and exploring additional features like SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configuration for enhanced email deliverability. The Edge Commerce Stack, available for $197, offers a comprehensive solution that includes deployment in 48 hours, loading 5 products, and end-to-end testing, ensuring your infrastructure is not only scalable but also secure and reliable.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
Cloudflare Workers automate your payment and delivery pipeline.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators looking for a comprehensive solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a powerful combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. You can find more information about this and other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, where you can explore the best fit for your digital commerce needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your NOWPayments webhook with Cloudflare Workers, start by setting up your NOWPayments account and generating an API key. Next, configure your Cloudflare Worker to listen for webhook notifications. Then, integrate your digital product delivery system, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. After that, test your setup with a small transaction to ensure everything works as expected. Finally, go live and start accepting crypto payments for your digital products, with the peace of mind that your infrastructure is secure, scalable, and reliable.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I convert Bitcoin to naira?
You can convert Bitcoin to naira through P2P exchanges or platforms like Binance, which offer conversion services for various cryptocurrencies.
What is the transaction fee for USDT on Solana?
The transaction fee for USDT on Solana averages fractions of a cent, making it a highly cost-effective option for transactions.
Can I use NOWPayments without Cloudflare Workers?
Yes, you can use NOWPayments without Cloudflare Workers, but integrating it with Workers enhances the automation and scalability of your payment and delivery pipeline.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?
USDT payments on Tron or Solana typically confirm within minutes, often faster than traditional payment systems like PayPal, which can take hours or even days to process transactions.
Is the Edge Commerce Stack suitable for beginners?

The Edge Commerce Stack is designed to be comprehensive and scalable, making it suitable for creators of all levels, including beginners, who want a reliable and secure infrastructure for their digital commerce needs.
